onPageTitle: Translate any text with a click
onPageText: Triple-click a paragraph and the translation appears right next to it. Detected the wrong language? Pick another one
tooltip: The movable-type printing press developed by Johannes Gutenberg around 1440 made books far cheaper to produce. Within a few decades, print shops had spread to more than 200 cities across Europe.
replaceTitle: Or replace the text right on the page
replaceText: Links and formatting stay in place. Buttons next to it change the source language or bring back the original
replaced: The movable-type printing press developed by Johannes Gutenberg around 1440 made books far cheaper to produce. Within a few decades, print shops had spread to more than 200 cities across Europe.
settingsText: Pick languages, how to trigger translation and the default engine. Asks before downloading a language pack, Google Translate stays an optional fallback.
modesText: Double click, triple click or right-click menu. Switch modes on any page with Alt+1, Alt+2, Alt+3
offlineText: On-page translation runs in your browser: language packs download once, then it works without the internet. Google Translate is there only if you turn it on.
marqueeSub: Offline translation right on the page
marqueeTooltip: The printing press developed by Gutenberg around 1440 made books far cheaper to produce.
